text:
mira: paging — p99 latency spike across eu-west, started ~11:32 UTC, streaming stalls reported by customers. Grafana shows p95 ~320ms, p99 ~1.2s, error budget burn. @oncall-bot alerted at 11:33 :rotating_light:
ops-bot: INCIDENT created: INC-2026-0421-93. Severity: Sev2. Shortlink: https://grafana.company/r/INC-2026-0421-93
jamal: seeing same on traces — a bunch of requests stuck in router handoff, backlog on lb-proxy-07 in eu-west-2.
sofia: customer report from acme-inc: streaming stalls and reconnects during long responses.
alex: joining — what changed around 11:30? any deploys?
mira: no deploys to runtime in last 2 hours. Routing policy rollouts did happen at 10:58 (weight rebalance).
jamal: digging into router logs — lots of WARN: "failed to find healthy backend for shard id=0x3f2a" and then retry loops. Copying snippet:
```
2026-04-21T11:31:12Z WARN router: shard_lookup miss shard=0x3f2a route_policy=eu-pref
2026-04-21T11:31:12Z INFO lb: fallback to remote pool pool=shared-eu delay=12ms
2026-04-21T11:31:13Z ERROR proxy: stream stall detected session=abcd-1234 wait=1800ms
```
sofia: that shard id maps to a hotkey partition for a few big customers; route policy weight change might've pushed them to a smaller pool.
alex: can you run quick heatmap of connections across backends? jamal?
jamal: running: `kubectl exec -n infra lb-debug -- heatmap --region eu-west-2 --window=5m`
ops-bot: heatmap job started (job id hb-778).
mira: meanwhile, I'm going to roll back the routing weight change to previous commit to see if it reduces handoffs.
sofia: +1 rollback, but we should be careful — rollback may rebalance and cause its own churn. Suggest canary rollback on one AZ first.
alex: can we temporarily pin hot partitions to the dedicated pool and enable eager fallback? That reduces cross-pool hops.
jamal: I can patch router config: set `prefer_local=true` for affected shard range and bump pool capacity by +10%. Applying now.
ops-bot: router-config patch applied (cfg-2026-04-21-11-36).
sofia: monitoring p99 — watching grafana: https://grafana.company/d/p99?orgId=1
ops-bot: grafana alert: p99 latency > 900ms for 3m.
mira: roll back routing rollout to commit abf12c on canary AZ-1 (doing manual disable of rollout).
jamal: verified heatmap: lb-proxy-07 had 62% of active streams for shard 0x3f2a, backend CPU at 92%. After patching prefer_local and capacity bump, active streams redistributed.
alex: any improvement in streaming stalls?
sofia: customer replication test shows stall reduction. p99 dropped to ~540ms after 3 minutes, p95 back to 260ms.
mira: great — keep monitoring for 30m, but we should still root cause: why weight rebalance routed hot shard to smaller pool? Possible policy bug in rollout planner.
jamal: I see a corner case: rollout math floors weights for pools under 5% capacity, which can demote hot shards during reweights. Filing bug: RT-1482.
sofia: tagging eng-runtime for follow up on policy edge-case + unit test. @eng-runtime please triage RT-1482 and check scheduler sim.
eng-runtime: acknowledged — will reproduce with simulator and PR fix. Assigning to @alex-runner.
alex: I'll take it. For immediate mitigation: recommend (1) tighten rollout min-weight floor, (2) add early-detect telemetry for hot-shard displacement, (3) add canary gating when heatmap shows >40% concentration.
mira: agreed. Also we need customer comms (ACME). Sofia, can you draft interim note: we mitigated routing misassignment, p99 improved, working on permanent fix?
sofia: drafting now.
mira: handoff to evening oncall at 12:05 UTC — @alex will continue runbook and drive RT-1482. Jamal continues monitoring infra metrics.
alex: acknowledged, I'll update the incident ticket with mitigation steps and link to reproducer.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421-93 status -> mitigated (manual routing rollback + prefer_local patch). Monitoring.
mira: final note before handoff: create postmortem template assigned to eng-runtime and ops with timeline, config diffs, and customer impact (ACME saw 6 partial stream reconnects, estimated p99 SLA blips 11:31-11:42 UTC).
sofia: will send customer update and cc success.
jamal: keeping grafana dashboard pinned. Will escalate if p99 rises above 800ms again.
alex: will open PR for config validation tests and schedule follow-up postmortem sync tomorrow 15:00 UTC.
mira: thanks team. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421-93 closed -> monitoring mode.
